name: Alsok Co.,Ltd.
summary: Alsok Co.,Ltd. engages in the electronic, stationed, and transportation security services in Japan and internationally. The company offers home security systems and services, such as housework contracting and safety confirmation services for senior citizens; stalker countermeasures for women; and long-term care services.
